faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: The essentials on privacy, pricing and community rules.
faq.q1: When does the AI assistant arrive?
faq.a1: It is in development. The idea: read shared interests, both profiles and the conversation context, then suggest topics and questions that actually fit. We will announce the launch in the app and on the blog.
faq.q2: Do other users see my phone number or Telegram handle?
faq.a2: No. Everything (swipes, text chat and voice messages) happens inside the platform without exposing your number. Sharing a direct Telegram contact is possible only when both people opt in via “Share contact”.
faq.q3: Is a paid subscription required to use Constella?
faq.a3: No. The core of Constella — daily Orbit swipes, messaging, voice notes, quests and achievements — is completely free. VIP adds unlimited swipes, Who Liked You, Incognito and Passport.
faq.q4: How does photo and 18+ verification work?
faq.a4: Uploaded photos are processed through AI moderation filters and human review. Constella is strictly 18+ to maintain community integrity.
faq.q5: How do I pay for VIP and in-app items?
faq.a5: Payments are made seamlessly through Telegram Stars via Apple Pay, Google Pay, or bank cards directly in the Telegram client.
faq.q6: Can I use Constella on desktop or laptop?
faq.a6: Yes! Constella works beautifully in desktop web browsers where you can log in with email or Telegram.

legal.note: This page describes how the service is actually built. It is not legal advice — have it reviewed before publishing.

privacy.p: A Telegram id or an email with a password hash, birthdate, gender, city, interests, photos, voice and text messages, swipes, matches, progress and active entitlements.
Nearby matching, the daily Orbit, safety and moderation, and delivering VIP. We do not sell your data to advertisers.
A profile shows the city and an approximate distance, never an exact address. VIP adds Passport, which lets you deliberately pick another city.
Registration is 18+: the birthdate is checked when the profile is created. Every photo goes through an automatic check and a human review.
Purchases run on Telegram Stars, processed by Telegram. We keep only the order and the resulting entitlement — no card data reaches us.
Deleting your account from the settings removes the profile, photos, chats and progress. Privacy questions go to support from the bot.

terms.p: The service is for adults; registering means you confirm you are 18 or older.
One profile per person. Access is not transferable and stays your responsibility.
Stalking, threats, scams, other people's photos, spam and any illegal content are grounds for a ban.
VIP costs 499★ and lasts 30 days with no auto-renewal. The perk list can change; the pricing table shows what is current.
We can restrict access for rule violations; you can delete your account at any time.
The service is provided as is. We do not guarantee mutual interest and we are not responsible for meetings outside the platform.

community.p: Your own photos, age and interests. Using someone else's pictures is the fastest route to a ban.
Respect a no. Contacts are exchanged only when both people agree.
Do not ask for transfers or steer conversations off-platform for money.
This is an adults' service, but public pornography, violence and anything involving minors is removed immediately.
Photos are checked automatically and by a person; reports and blocks are read by a moderator.
Every chat and profile has a report button. Reporting speeds things up; it does not make you the problem.
